description: Named variables of map7_s02 (Nowhere - Alessa vs. Dahlia cutscene) that its Lua reads and writes with sh.map.get / sh.map.set or passes by name ("name[i]"). Each entry says where the value lives: "symbol" (an array of tables.json or a game variable shared with the engine; with "storage" too, the storage is used where the symbol is missing), "object" (the draw records of world_objects.json, starting at that object) or "storage" (a value only the scripts keep, alive for the whole run); "type" is s8/u8/s16/u16/s32/u32 (default s32) or ref (an address); "count" elements lie "stride" bytes apart from "offset". "layout" gives several names at once: vec3 (.x/.y/.z, s32 Q12 metres), svec3 (s16, Q12 turns for angles), pose (.pos, .rot) and placement (.pos). Variables every map shares are in gamedata/config/map_vars.json; this file is looked up first, and a mod patches it with its own copy. On map7_s02 (Nowhere, Alessa and Dahlia): the voice line and the voice commands of Lisa's tape, the hallway, the nurse room and the plan; the machine hum position and state; the jelly beans (fall speed, drop height, 16 scatter angles and speeds, 16 poses); chain rattle, screwdriver and fuse box spark timers; the last door seal; the puzzle cursor and the letter keypad; LisaDoor, the SlidingDoor and KitchenDoor objects, the bed and its cover; the stone panels; ghost_doctor_bones (the bone buffer the Ghost Doctor is loaded into); time_stone is never placed on this map (the early copy moves an unused pose).
